gallery.title: File:LSticketbooth.jpg
gallery.credit: Transferred from en.wikipedia to Commons by DanTD.
gallery.description:
Personal photo of Little Silver, NJ Train Station ticket window.
This is a contemporary photo of the Little Silver station designed by H.H. Richardson for the New York and Longbranch (Pennsylvania Railroad). The picture shows the station agent's bay window (not the ticket window, which was inside). The New York and Longbranch is now called the North Jersey Coast Line and is operated by New Jersey Transit, "New Jersey's public transportation corporation."
categories: National Register of Historic Places with known IDs

gallery.filename: Dune restoration at Wreck Pond Inlet (26505381730).jpg
gallery.title: File:Dune restoration at Wreck Pond Inlet (26505381730).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service Northeast Region
gallery.description:
The Wreck Pond Inlet and dunes restoration project broke ground in mid December 2015 in Monmouth County, N.J. This project will construct a 600-foot secondary culvert connecting Wreck Pond to the ocean and enhancing fish passage, improving water quality, and reducing flooding risks. The work, supported by federal funding from the Hurricane Sandy Disaster Relief Act, is anticipated to be completed in summer 2017.

Photo credit:  Katie Conrad/USFWS
